name: open_integrator_todo
title: Open a todo for the integrator
description: Put machine work (an installation, a setting) in the integrator's queue, not a message; the owners do not get it, it waits for a connected integrator. Its answer comes back to you. An owner decision is not a todo: use ask_human.

task_key.description: A card projectman already follows (an open or handed-over obligation) is refused with obligation_tracked: projectman hands that step over itself.
